messages:
olivia: Heads-up — I'm seeing a 2–3x p95 latency spike across hosted endpoints after the v2.1 rollout. Started 09:41 UTC. Not all models affected; seems tied to the rolled model variants. @sre-oncall can you take a look?

deploy-bot: deploy event: user:ci/cd pipeline #7845 rolled model redwood/open-llm-v2.1 to cluster us-east-1-gpupool at 2025-11-12T09:39:12Z :rocket:

raj: looking now. Any recent infra changes? kernel updates or runtime flags?

olivia: no infra change AFAIK. The change was only tokenizer normalization tweak + new quantized weights. Canary was small but rollout completed 09:38.

mia: adding perf notes — model's avg seq-len jumped from 128 -> 240 for a subset of requests after tokenizer tweak (we see more preserved tokens). That could hit attention and KV-cache size.

hana: ran quick profiling on a repro trace. Attach logs:
```
[09:45] p50 45ms p95 720ms p99 1200ms
[09:45] kernel_selector: selected fallback=ref_attention for 35% of calls
[09:46] kv_cache_size per-request: 1.9x previous
[09:47] batch_util: queueing delay increased from 12ms->85ms
```

hana: notes: fallback to ref kernels correlates with longer seq-lens + new quantization layout; we see more memcpy+transpose overhead. Also KV cache miss/evict thrash on long histories.

raj: noisy-neighbor check — there's a background finetune job on same GPU nodes (job id cntrl-432). Throttle was off for the job. I'm pausing it.

sre-oncall: paused cntrl-432, but infra wasn't the only factor. We still see elevated p95 on a portion of requests routed to us-east-1-gpupool.

olivia: rollback option? Can we pin traffic back to v2.0 until we get a fix.

deploy-bot: rollback triggered by olivia: pin traffic to redwood/open-llm-v2.0 for service api/* at 09:54 UTC

mia: after rollback p95 dropped back to ~60ms for the same trace. Canary failure reproduced on v2.1 when forced on a small sample.

hana: root cause hypothesis: tokenizer change increases seq-len leading to different kernel selection path + quantization layout change causing suboptimal kernel choice and KV cache growth. Combination causes batching latency + cache thrash. Repro plan: run perf harness with seq-len distribution from logs, compare kernel selector decisions and memory traffic.

raj: mitigation actions:
- pin rollout -> done
- add rollout guard to require perf smoke <1.2x p95
- fix kernel selector to prioritize optimized kernels for new quant layouts
- add a KV-cache eviction threshold to avoid thrash

olivia: filing PERF-1991 with repro, profiler traces, and proposed mitigation. Assigned to hana and raj. ETA EOD tomorrow for hotfix.

sre-oncall: monitoring dashboards set to alert if p95 > 200ms for any route. :eyes:

olivia: thanks team. We should add a checklist for future tokenizer/model rollouts: perf harness with seq-len sampling, kernel-selector dry-run, KV cache regression test.

mia: I'll add those to the rollout playbook and create an automated perf check in CI.

raj: re-enabled autoscaling and will watch GPU utilization. If anything spikes I'll notify.

olivia: closing thread once PERF-1991 is created and we have the hotfix plan. :thumbsup:
